content.short: HackQuest provides self-guided Web3 developer education platform.
content.description: HackQuest provides expert-curated, zero-to-hero Web3 smart-contract development learning tracks and certifications co-issued by ecosystems including Arbitrum, Solana, and Mantle Network. All HackQuest courses are built following the Universal Design of Learning (UDL), ensuring accessibility and inclusivity for all learners, regardless of abilities or learning styles. The program supports learners as they advance through the material and engage with the broader ecosystem of Web3 smart contracts.
content.meta: HackQuest offers expert-curated Web3 smart-contract tracks and co-issued certifications. Discover HackQuest and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: A Step-by-Step Guide to the Bittensor Learning Track
resources.tldr: Bittensor prices intelligence through market mechanisms across subnets of miners and validators. A structured way into a design that resists summary.

resources.title: A Step-by-Step Guide to the Nouns Learning Track
resources.tldr: One NFT auctioned every day, forever, funding a treasury the holders govern. Nouns is a strange, instructive design, and this shows how it holds together.

resources.title: A Step-by-Step Guide to the Eclipse Learning Track
resources.tldr: Eclipse runs the Solana VM as an Ethereum layer 2, a useful lens on what an execution environment is versus where settlement happens.
